summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held June 2, 2026. No special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine notice of a shareholder meeting with attached meeting materials, including press release, notice, agenda, explanatory notes, proposed articles amendment, and proxy form. No terms, advisor, or strategic action are involved. This is a procedural corporate filing equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07 meeting notification. Watch for standard meeting outcomes but no risk-arb angle applies.
